text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello's upperclassman had worked 
tirelessly, yet never managed to stand at 
center stage for a Winning Live. ...Light 
Hello had watched it all happen, right by 
her side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding those past memories close, she 
continues her PR activities today. 
However, there was an Umamusume gazing 
angrily at her promotional work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Silence Suzuka was troubled. 
She still didn't understand "the meaning 
of Winning Lives" that Agnes Tachyon had 
hinted was tied to her running.
